about.title: About This Project
about.introduction: ai.cloudto.io is an AI-powered background removal tool that runs entirely in your browser using WebGL-accelerated ONNX Runtime, ensuring your privacy and security.

features.title: Key Features
features.privacy: Privacy First: Images never uploaded to server
features.free: Completely Free: No registration or payment
features.openSource: Open Source: Built on ONNX Runtime Web

section1.title: Data Collection
section1.content: This website does not collect or store any images uploaded by users. All image processing happens entirely in your browser and never uploads to our servers.

section2.title: Logging
section2.content: We only log basic access information (timestamp, browser type, referrer) for analytics and service improvement. These logs do not contain any personally identifiable information.

section3.title: Third-party Services
section3.content: This website uses Google Analytics and Google AdSense. These services may set cookies. You can refuse cookies through your browser settings.
